name: Lewis Wilson

projects.name: PitchMetrics

projects.name: Football Scouting Model

projects.name: Adaptive Microneedle Patch

projects.name: Sky Viewer
projects.summary: An interactive star map showing the sky from your location at any date and time, recommending targets for the night from altitude, sky darkness, equipment and the cloud forecast. Conceived with his grandad.
